title: Taxation (Trustee Beneficiary Non-disclosure Tax) (No. 2) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would increase the rate of trustee beneficiary non-disclosure tax imposed under the No. 2 Act as part of the DisabilityCare Australia package.
It would set the rate at 47 per cent, combining the maximum income tax rate with a Medicare levy component of 2 per cent.
The amendment would apply from the 2014-15 income year to the covered trust distributions where the separate non-disclosure provision in section 102UK does not apply.
changes: The rate specified in the No. 2 tax Act would increase to 47 per cent.
The rate calculation would incorporate the higher Medicare levy component.
The new rate would apply for 2014-15 and subsequent income years.
summary.affected: Trustees covered by this non-disclosure tax on income distributed to trustees of closely held trusts are affected.

speeches.speaker: David Bradbury
speeches.brief: Introduced consequential tax amendments to raise the trustee beneficiary non-disclosure tax rate from 46.5 to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014, matching the increase in the Medicare levy from 1.5 to 2 per cent to fund DisabilityCare Australia.

speeches.speaker: Jacinta Collins
speeches.brief: Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.
